interface.name: serenity_input_capture_manager_v1
interface.description: The manager global. One per compositor; only offered when input capture is enabled for the session.

request.name: create_session
request.description: Create a session for the application identified by app_id. The session is inert until further requests are made on it.

interface.name: serenity_input_capture_session_v1
interface.description: Per-application input-capture session. May be destroyed at any time; the compositor tears down any associated EIS client and stops any capture.

request.name: connect_to_eis
request.description: Ask the compositor for the session's EIS implementation file descriptor. The compositor replies with the eis_fd event; the fd is passed to a libei receiver context (ei_setup_backend_fd). May be called once.

request.name: get_zones
request.description: Ask for the current zones (logical outputs). The compositor replies with the zones event. A zone is a rectangle (width, height, x, y).

request.name: set_pointer_barriers
request.description: Replace this session's pointer barriers. The barriers array is a packed array of barriers, each 20 bytes: { uint32 id; int32 x1, y1, x2, y2 }. A barrier is axis-aligned: horizontal if y1 == y2, vertical if x1 == x2; diagonal barriers are rejected. zone_set must equal the last zone_set from get_zones. The compositor replies with pointer_barriers_result listing any rejected barrier ids. Setting barriers disarms capture until enable is called again.

request.name: enable
request.description: Arm capturing. Once armed, crossing a pointer barrier activates capture (the activated event) and events for the granted capabilities are then delivered over EIS until release/disable. capabilities is a bitmask (1 = keyboard, 2 = pointer).

request.name: disable
request.description: Disarm capturing. If capture is active it is deactivated first; the disabled event follows.

request.name: release
request.description: End an ongoing capture. activation_id must match the currently active capture (a stale id is ignored). cursor_x/cursor_y suggest where the pointer should be placed when capture ends.

event.name: zones
event.description: The zones array is a packed array of zones, each 16 bytes: { uint32 width; uint32 height; int32 x; int32 y }.

event.name: pointer_barriers_result
event.description: The failed array is a packed array of uint32 barrier ids that were rejected.

event.name: activated
event.description: Capture has been triggered (by crossing pointer barrier barrier_id; 0 if unknown). Input events are now delivered over the EIS connection, after an EIS start_emulating with sequence == activation_id.

event.name: deactivated
event.description: Capture ended; input events are no longer delivered.

event.name: disabled
event.description: The session is no longer armed; enable must be called again to rearm.
